subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured duration/span contract, and if so which requested event families should become lifecycle spans versus remain point events?
rationale: Current code and docs expose trajectory rows as timestamped events, while changing them to duration-bearing spans affects exported diagnostics schema, support tooling, and transcript-derived tool event semantics.

options.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and approve a focused design/fix that adds measured duration fields for real lifecycle operations with docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only and use OTel for latency
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as an event stream, update docs to say so, and route actionable latency measurement through diagnostics-otel and the related latency issue.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Handle runtime lifecycle events, transcript-derived tool reconstruction, and OTel context timing as separate follow-ups so each gets the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and approve a focused design/fix that adds measured duration fields for real lifecycle operations with docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent trajectory-file history in the available GitHub path history and current checkout, making them the best routing candidate for the schema decision.
